name: FF_FDI_USAGES
description: This table contains compiler-generated descriptions of database items used in a formula.

columns.name: FORMULA_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the formula the data item usage belongs to. Foreign key to FF_FORMULAS.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: ITEM_NAME
columns.description: Name of the item the usage is for.

columns.name: DATA_TYPE
columns.description: Data type of the formula data item.

columns.name: USAGE
columns.description: Subtype field (D, L, I, O, B, U).

columns.name: ITEM_GENERATED_NAME
columns.description: System generated bind variable for the item.

columns.name: INDICATOR_VAR_NAME
columns.description: Generated bind variable that indicates whether or not a returned value is not null.

columns.name: LOAD_WHEN_RUNNING
columns.description: Y or N flag that indicates whether item gets loaded at runtime.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: Usage-specific surrogate key for item.

columns.name: ROUTE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for database item route. Foreign key to FF_ROUTES.

columns.name: USER_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for database item user entity. Foreign key to FF_USER_ENTITIES.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Validity status. A status other than V means that the formula needs to be recompiled.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: COMPILE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the formula compile.

columns.name: ORA_EDITION_CONTEXT
columns.description: Indicates the edition based redefinition (EBR) context to which the row belongs - either 'ALL', ''SET1' or 'SET2'.
